translations.web: Slanderous men have been in you to shed blood. In you they have eaten on the mountains. They have committed lewdness among you.
translations.bsb: Among you are slanderous men bent on bloodshed; within you are those who eat on the mountain shrines and commit acts of indecency.
translations.kjv: In thee are men that carry tales to shed blood: and in thee they eat upon the mountains: in the midst of thee they commit lewdness.
translations.asv: Slanderous men have been in thee to shed blood; and in thee they have eaten upon the mountains: in the midst of thee they have committed lewdness.
